A quick introduction

Briefing

Meet VehicleLens. This dashboard makes a large set of vehicle registration records easier to explore. See which categories lead, where registrations are recorded, and how the fuel mix changes over time.

About this project. The dashboard brings 499,995 valid records together into views by vehicle type, state, maker, model, fuel and month. In the sample, the records represent about 2.8 million weighted registrations. The charts and tables are here to help you explore the patterns and decide what to look at next.

A few things you can explore
  • Which vehicle categories dominate, and is growth slowing?
  • Which states and manufacturers lead the market?
  • How fast is the fuel mix shifting towards electric?
  • Which vehicle fits a need, and how do two compare?
  • What does the full picture look like for one brand or one state?

Methodology & coverage

Version 15

500,000 source rows; 5 invalid-year rows (102 registrations) excluded. The retained 499,995 rows represent 2,806,654 registrations within this sample. These are not population estimates of India's total market. Annual summaries use calendar years; April–December 2020 is partial. December 2025 coverage and the original extraction date are unknown.

Counts and attributes are weighted by vehicleCount. Average GVW excludes zero/missing weights. Pure EV means ELECTRIC(BOV) or PURE EV; hybrids are separate. The “Four Wheeler” group includes motor/passenger categories such as tractors and buses, not just passenger cars. Models are grouped by manufacturer, case-insensitive trimmed model name and category; missing names are explicitly labelled.

1,244 raw manufacturer names become 1,238 groups: three Tata entities and five Volkswagen/Skoda entities are consolidated. All other legal entities remain separate. Full mapping is included below.

Manufacturer normalization mapping
  • Tata Motors: TATA MOTORS LTD; TATA MOTORS PASSENGER VEHICLES LTD; TATA PASSENGER ELECTRIC MOBILITY LTD.
  • Volkswagen Group: SKODA AUTO VOLKSWAGEN INDIA PVT LTD; VOLKSWAGEN AG; VOLKSWAGEN INDIA PVT LTD; SKODA AUTO AS; SKODA AUTO INDIA PVT LTD.

Source: supplied Indian RTO-style registration sample and state/month/fuel aggregate. The original publisher and source URL were not provided. CC BY 4.0 license. Changes: year exclusions, grouping, registration-weighted summaries and dashboard presentation. Build: version 15.

Registrations by vehicle type, 2020–2025

Annual

Stacked annual volume across the five category groups

Two-wheelers account for 73.6% of all registrations in this sample, with four-wheelers a distant second at 19.4%. Growth is uneven: goods vehicles declined in 2024 and 2025, and three-wheelers declined in 2024 before recovering.

Year-over-Year Growth

%

Sample registration growth rate · 2021 (amber) is inflated by the partial 2020 base

Recorded sample growth falls from +55.5% in 2021 to +2.5% in 2025. The 2020 base is partial and December 2025 coverage is unverified; these figures alone do not establish a change in market demand.

Top 15 States by Total Registrations

All vehicle categories combined, 2020–2025

Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu lead registration volume within this sample. The records do not establish the causes of regional differences.

Two-Wheeler vs Four-Wheeler, Top 10 States

Two-wheelers outnumber four-wheelers in every leading state, though the ratio varies

Bihar and West Bengal show the widest two-wheeler-to-four-wheeler gap among top states, while Maharashtra and Gujarat have relatively stronger four-wheeler penetration.

Top 10 Manufacturers Overall

Across all vehicle categories

Hero MotoCorp and Honda Motorcycle & Scooter lead the sampled registration volume; their records are overwhelmingly in the two-wheeler category.

Sample Volume vs Electric Vehicle Share

Monthly

Total registrations (bars, left axis) against EV share of total (line, right axis)

EV share varies month to month: 5.52% in October 2025, 5.66% in November and 8.20% in December. Treat the latest month cautiously because its coverage is unverified.
